note: Diplomacy and spies between the great powers (v2 step 7). Each ruler holds an opinion of each other power (-100 to 100) that moves `pull` of the way each month towards a target: its `start` view, plus its lore `agenda`, plus treaties, less grievances, less `atWar` while at war. Grievances: a declaration of war is `grievance.war` to the victim and `grievance.warmonger` to every other power; a city taken from a power is `grievance.city` to it; grievances fade `grievance.fade` a month. Treaties: peace ends a war (each side's occupied cities are handed back, kept ones stay); an alliance (opinion `alliance.min` or more) lets armies cross and be supplied and brings the ally into a defensive war; open borders (`openBorders.min`) lets armies cross; a trade deal (`trade.min`) gives each side `trade.crowns` a month. A power answers yes when its opinion is high enough; it takes peace when its war is going badly (war score behind by `peace.behind`) or the war has dragged on `peace.weary` months and its opinion is above `peace.hate`. The AI declares war on a power it hates (opinion below `aiWar.hate`) when it is `aiWar.ratio` times stronger, at `aiWar.chance` a month, once `aiWar.after` months have passed. Spies: each power builds a network in one realm at a time (`spies.grow` a month; others fade `spies.fade`); an army of spies in a realm's land adds `spies.agents`. Operations spend network: sabotage wears works in one city, theft takes treasury, incitement raises unrest; each risks being caught (`catchBase` less a quarter of the network), which costs `caught` opinion.

temeria.text: Holds the lesser crowns of the south: resents any other power that makes them its vassals.

redania.text: Knows first, strikes second: resents a rival with more envoys at the smaller courts.

kaedwen.text: Trusts the sword: respects a strong army and scorns a weak one.

aedirn.text: Guards the valley and the mines: hates foreign armies on its borders.

nilfgaard.text: The White Flame's long plan: hates the northern crowns standing together.

alliance.name: Alliance
alliance.text: Our armies may cross each other's lands and be fed there, and each comes to the other's aid when attacked.

openBorders.name: Open borders
openBorders.text: Our armies may cross each other's lands.

trade.name: Trade deal
trade.text: Each side gains crowns a month.

sabotage.name: Sabotage
sabotage.text: Wear the works of one of their cities.
